faq.question: Pregunta 1: ¿HMU Link es una página web?
faq.answer: No. Es una tarjeta de presentación digital alojada online, creada para reunir la información y accesos más importantes de tu negocio en un solo link.

faq.question: Pregunta 2: ¿Qué puedo incluir en mi HMU Link?
faq.answer: WhatsApp, teléfono, email, ubicación en Google Maps, redes sociales, botón para dejar reseñas, servicios y precios si quieres mostrarlos, además de otros enlaces importantes de tu negocio.

faq.question: Pregunta 3: ¿Mis clientes pueden guardar mi tarjeta?
faq.answer: Sí. Tendrán un botón para guardar fácilmente tus datos en sus contactos y otro para agregar tu tarjeta a Google Wallet. Apple Wallet estará disponible próximamente.

faq.question: Pregunta 4: ¿Cómo comparto mi HMU Link?
faq.answer: Puedes enviarlo como un solo link por WhatsApp, redes sociales, email o mensaje, y también compartirlo mediante código QR.

faq.question: Pregunta 5: ¿Puedo elegir el diseño?
faq.answer: Sí. Puedes elegir entre 12 diseños diferentes y seleccionar el estilo que mejor se adapte a tu negocio.

en.short_description:
Don't miss opportunities because your customers can't find how to contact you. 

Make it as easy as touching a button to find you, save you, and reach you! 

HMU Link brings together your WhatsApp, phone, email, Google Maps, services, and more in a single digital card.
en.client_care_text: No appointment needed, first come, first served

services.name: HMU Link
Everything your customers need to find you, contact you, and save you, in one link.
Choose from 12 designs and select the style that best fits your business.
WhatsApp, call, and email at a touch so your customers can contact you directly.
Direct location on Google Maps to make it easier for customers to reach your business.
Your social media in one place so your customers can access them without having to search for them.
Button to leave you a review that takes your customers directly to where they can write their opinion.
Services and prices, if you want to show them, organized clearly within your card.
Button to save your contact and easily add your details to your customer's phone contacts.
Button to add your card to Google Wallet, so your customers can keep it saved on their phone and find it easily.
A single link easy to share via WhatsApp, social media, email, or message.
QR code to open and share your card from printed material, counters, packaging, and other physical points.
No apps or installations: it opens directly from any phone, neither you nor your customers need to download anything.

policies: Choose from 12 designs and customize your HMU Link with your business information. You decide what data, links, services, and prices you want to display. Your card works from any phone.

faq.question: Question 1: Is HMU Link a website?
faq.answer: No. It is a digital business card hosted online, created to gather the most important information and access points of your business in one link.

faq.question: Question 2: What can I include in my HMU Link?
faq.answer: WhatsApp, phone, email, location on Google Maps, social media, button to leave reviews, services and prices if you want to show them, as well as other important links for your business.

faq.question: Question 3: Can my customers save my card?
faq.answer: Yes. They will have a button to easily save your information in their contacts and another to add your card to Google Wallet. Apple Wallet will be available soon.

faq.question: Question 4: How do I share my HMU Link?
faq.answer: You can send it as a single link via WhatsApp, social media, email, or message, and also share it via QR code.

faq.question: Question 5: Can I choose the design?
faq.answer: Yes. You can choose from 12 different designs and select the style that best fits your business.

featured_package.name: Your business always updated
featured_package.description:
Your HMU Link can be updated when your phone, location, hours, or links change, without throwing away cards or reprinting them.
A card that doesn't become obsolete - One-time payment / no monthly fees.
